usecases.name: Create Product
usecases.description: Register the product code, name, brand, material, dimensions, application, color code, description, and technical specifications.

usecases.name: Update Product Information
usecases.description: Update product details while controlling changes affecting existing batches and inventory documents.

usecases.name: Discontinue Product
usecases.description: Prevent the product from being selected in new sales orders while retaining stock and transaction history.

usecases.name: Configure Tile Categories
usecases.description: Maintain tile types, applications, materials, and dimensions, such as 30 × 30, 40 × 40, and 60 × 60 cm.

usecases.name: Configure Packaging Specifications
usecases.description: Record pieces per box, area per piece, and area per box for each product.

usecases.name: Configure Unit Conversions
usecases.description: Define piece, box, and square-meter conversions for each product and identify its base inventory unit.

usecases.name: Create Product Batch
usecases.description: Record batch number, product code, color code, production date, and manufacturer; validate batch uniqueness.

usecases.name: Update Product Batch
usecases.description: Modify batch data and retain change history once inventory transactions exist for the batch.

usecases.name: View and Trace Product Batch
usecases.description: View batch details, storage locations, inventory balances, and associated transaction history.

usecases.name: Create Supplier
usecases.description: Register supplier name, supplier code, address, telephone number, and contact person.

usecases.name: Update Supplier
usecases.description: Update supplier details and cooperation status and access related purchasing documents.

usecases.name: Create Customer
usecases.description: Register customer name, telephone number, contact information, and delivery address.

usecases.name: Update Customer
usecases.description: Update customer information and view sales order history.

usecases.name: Create Storage Location
usecases.description: Define area, aisle, rack, location code, and storage capacity within a warehouse.

usecases.name: Update Storage Location Status
usecases.description: Edit or deactivate a storage location after checking whether any inventory remains there.

usecases.name: Create Purchase Order
usecases.description: Create a purchase order specifying supplier, products, quantities, units of measure, and expected receipt date.

usecases.name: Update or Cancel Purchase Order
usecases.description: Amend or cancel a purchase order, subject to validation of quantities already received.

usecases.name: Approve Purchase Order
usecases.description: Review a purchase order and approve, reject, or return it for revision.

usecases.name: Record Supplier Confirmation
usecases.description: Record confirmed quantities, shortfalls, and the supplier’s expected delivery schedule.

usecases.name: Track Purchase Order Progress
usecases.description: Track ordered, confirmed, received, and outstanding quantities.

usecases.name: Register Supplier Delivery
usecases.description: Receive supplier goods and delivery documents and link them to the corresponding purchase order.

usecases.name: Inspect Received Goods
usecases.description: Count and verify product, quantity, batch number, color code, production date, and goods condition.

usecases.name: Record Receiving Discrepancy
usecases.description: Record shortages, over-deliveries, incorrect products or batches, and broken or damaged goods.

usecases.name: Create Goods Receipt from Purchase Order
usecases.description: Prepare a goods receipt referencing the purchase order and receiving results, with batch, quantity, and stock status.

usecases.name: Approve Receiving Discrepancy Resolution
usecases.description: Authorize quantities to receive, hold for resolution, or return to the supplier.

usecases.name: Confirm Goods Receipt
usecases.description: Finalize the goods receipt and increase inventory by product, batch, and stock status.

usecases.name: Create Supplier Return Request
usecases.description: Request a supplier return referencing the purchase order or receiving record, batch, quantity, and return reason.

usecases.name: Approve Supplier Return
usecases.description: Review supporting documents and approve or reject a supplier return request.

usecases.name: Confirm Supplier Return Dispatch
usecases.description: Confirm actual return quantities; reduce stock only when the goods were previously received into inventory.

usecases.name: Allocate Storage Locations
usecases.description: Allocate newly received goods to storage locations by batch, color code, and quantity after capacity checks.

usecases.name: Create Location Transfer
usecases.description: Create a transfer document for a batch and quantity between source and destination locations in the same warehouse.

usecases.name: Confirm Location Transfer
usecases.description: Confirm physical relocation, decrease the source location balance, and increase the destination location balance without changing total stock.

usecases.name: Move Goods to Pending Inspection
usecases.description: Mark quantities awaiting inspection as unavailable for sales allocation.

usecases.name: Record Goods Inspection Results
usecases.description: Record inspected, accepted, and rejected quantities and reasons by batch.

usecases.name: Approve Release to Available Stock
usecases.description: Approve inspection results and release acceptable goods to available inventory.

usecases.name: Record and Isolate Damaged Goods
usecases.description: Identify affected product, batch, quantity, and location and isolate goods with quality issues.

usecases.name: Resolve Isolated Goods
usecases.description: Decide whether to reinspect, return to the supplier, or adjust inventory using appropriate documents.

usecases.name: View Inventory by Batch and Location
usecases.description: View quantities by product, batch, color code, storage location, and stock status.

usecases.name: Monitor Available and Reserved Inventory
usecases.description: Distinguish physical, available, sales-reserved, and non-issuable stock.

usecases.name: Configure and Monitor Low-Stock Alerts
usecases.description: Set minimum inventory thresholds and view products below the configured levels.

usecases.name: View Inventory Transaction History
usecases.description: Trace goods receipts, issues, location transfers, stock-status changes, and inventory adjustments.

usecases.name: Create Stocktake
usecases.description: Define stocktake scope, schedule, and assigned personnel.

usecases.name: Record Stocktake Counts
usecases.description: Record physically counted quantities by product, batch, color code, and location.

usecases.name: Reconcile Stocktake Variances
usecases.description: Compare physical counts with book stock and record discrepancies and their causes.

usecases.name: Approve Stocktake Results
usecases.description: Review count results and either approve them or request a recount.

usecases.name: Confirm Inventory Adjustment
usecases.description: Finalize an approved adjustment and update inventory by the correct batch and location.

usecases.name: Create Sales Order
usecases.description: Create a sales order with customer, products, quantities, units, reference prices, and expected delivery date.

usecases.name: Update or Cancel Sales Order
usecases.description: Amend or cancel an order while checking previously reserved, issued, or delivered quantities.

usecases.name: Allocate and Reserve Stock by Batch
usecases.description: Select batches and reserve quantities for an order; indicate when multiple batches are needed.

usecases.name: Create Goods Issue Request
usecases.description: Create an issue request from a sales order specifying products, quantities, batches, and delivery installment.

usecases.name: Approve Goods Issue Request
usecases.description: Verify available stock, batches, and requested quantities; approve, reject, or return the request for revision.

usecases.name: Pick and Inspect Outbound Goods
usecases.description: Pick the approved goods and verify quantities, batches, and color codes before dispatch.

usecases.name: Confirm Goods Issue
usecases.feature: Goods Issue Management Goods Issue Documents
usecases.description: Finalize goods issue, decrease inventory at the correct batch and location, and update quantities issued against the sales order.

usecases.name: Create Delivery Batch
usecases.description: Define the related issue documents, delivery date, address, recipient, and planned delivery quantities.

usecases.name: Confirm Delivery to Customer
usecases.description: Record actual delivered quantity, time, recipient, goods condition, and proof of delivery.

usecases.name: Handle Short or Failed Delivery
usecases.description: Record undelivered quantities and arrange redelivery or return goods to inventory with appropriate documents.

usecases.name: Track Sales Order Fulfillment
usecases.description: Track ordered, reserved, issued, delivered, and outstanding quantities.

usecases.name: Create Customer Return Request
usecases.feature: Customer Returns Management Customer Return Requests
usecases.description: Create a return request referring to a sales order or goods issue, with product, batch, quantity, and reason.

usecases.name: Inspect Customer Returns
usecases.description: Inspect returned quantities, batch numbers, color codes, and condition; identify goods eligible for restocking.

usecases.name: Approve Customer Return Receipt
usecases.description: Approve restockable quantities and the handling of goods that do not meet acceptance criteria.

usecases.name: Confirm Customer Return Receipt
usecases.description: Finalize the return receipt and update batch-level quantities and inventory status.

usecases.name: View Inventory Movement Report
usecases.description: Report opening balances, receipts, issues, adjustments, and closing balances by product, batch, and period.

usecases.name: View Inventory by Batch and Location Report
usecases.feature: Reporting Management Stock by Location Reports
usecases.description: Report inventory by batch, location, status, stock age, and products with low or aging stock.

usecases.name: View Purchasing and Receiving Report
usecases.description: Report ordered, confirmed, received, outstanding, and supplier-returned quantities by supplier.

usecases.name: View Sales and Dispatch Report
usecases.description: Report ordered, reserved, issued, delivered, and outstanding quantities by product, sales order, and customer.

usecases.name: View Stocktake and Adjustment Report
usecases.description: Report stocktake outcomes, variances, causes, and adjustment history.

usecases.name: Manage Employee Accounts
usecases.description: Create, update, and lock employee accounts according to their assigned roles.

usecases.name: Configure Roles and Permissions
usecases.description: Set access rights for viewing data, creating requests, approving records, and confirming business documents.

usecases.name: Configure and Manage Warehouses
usecases.description: Maintain warehouse codes, names, addresses, statuses, and responsible personnel for multiple warehouses in one store.

usecases.name: Configure Warehouse-Specific Locations
usecases.description: Assign each storage location to exactly one warehouse and enforce location-code uniqueness within that warehouse.

usecases.name: View Warehouse-Specific and Consolidated Inventory
usecases.description: View stock by warehouse, batch, color, location, and status, with consolidated balances across warehouses.

usecases.name: Create Inter-Warehouse Transfer Request
usecases.description: Specify source warehouse, destination warehouse, batch, quantity, stock status, and reason for the transfer.

usecases.name: Confirm Transfer Dispatch
usecases.description: Count and issue goods from the source warehouse and place dispatched quantities in in-transit status until received.

usecases.name: Confirm Transfer Receipt
usecases.description: Compare quantities received with those dispatched and receive goods into the destination warehouse by batch, location, and condition.

usecases.name: Reconcile Transfer Discrepancy
usecases.description: Record and resolve shortages, surpluses, or damage between transfer dispatch and receipt before closing the transfer.
